evidence.quote:
two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifies the gate by citing observed evidence of unsigned artifacts, arguing from cause to necessity.
Summary codifies the gate as a formal rule and names an owner, exercising both process authority and control over the decision record.
